title: Code for: Fine-mapping HLA-II haplotypes in Alzheimer's disease and healthy longevity reveals distinct associations with microglial HLA-II load and neuropathology
description: Analysis code for the preprint Fine-mapping HLA-II haplotypes in Alzheimer's disease and healthy longevity reveals distinct associations with microglial HLA-II load and neuropathology (medRxiv, 2026). The repository contains the data preparation pipelines for the study cohort, the 100-plus Study and the Netherlands Brain Bank replication cohort (clumping, conditional analysis, LD and HLA allele association), and the scripts that produce the figures and tables of the manuscript.
